import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Sort by user_id, then event_ts, then event_id (stable, explicit tie-break)
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Calendar date (server local) of each event, kept as datetime64 (midnight) for
    # robust comparisons and direct use as output dtype.
    events["event_date"] = events["event_ts"].dt.floor("D")

    # Previous event's timestamp and date within the same user (in sorted order)
    events["prev_event_ts"] = events.groupby("user_id")["event_ts"].shift(1)
    events["prev_event_date"] = events.groupby("user_id")["event_date"].shift(1)

    # Exact timedelta gap (no float conversion -> avoids precision issues at the
    # 45-minute boundary)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - events["prev_event_ts"]
    threshold = pd.Timedelta(minutes=45)

    is_first = events["prev_event_ts"].isna()
    gap_too_big = (~is_first) & (gap > threshold)
    date_changed = (~is_first) & (events["event_date"] != events["prev_event_date"])

    events["new_session"] = is_first | gap_too_big | date_changed

    # Session numbering per user
    events["session_num"] = events.groupby("user_id")["new_session"].cumsum().astype("int64")

    # Aggregate into sessions
    user_sessions = events.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], as_index=False).agg(
        session_date=("event_date", "first"),
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    )

    user_sessions["session_date"] = pd.to_datetime(user_sessions["session_date"])

    user_sessions = user_sessions[
        ["user_id", "session_num", "session_date", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    user_sessions = user_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "session_num"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"user_sessions": user_sessions}
